author: Unity
description:
Interactive 3D is becoming essential across industries - but for a lot of teams, it’s still out of reach.

That’s why we built Unity Studio - an intuitive, web-based, no-code editor that helps teams across industries, from manufacturing to retail, turn existing 3D assets into interactive experiences, straight from the browser.

Check out what it looks like to go from a static 3D file to a fully interactive demo in under an hour. 

🔗 Try it out yourself with a free 30 day Unity Studio trial: https://unity.com/products/unity-studio 

#3D #InteractiveContent #NoCode #Productivity #DigitalTransformation #Innovation #GameDev #Unity
title: Unity Studio is an intuitive, web-based editor that turns 3D assets into interactive experiences
